description: Master evaluation set grounded in the 7 finalized cleaned Markdown guidelines. Designed for chunking/embedding retrieval, hybrid retrieval, reranking, generation, citation, table retrieval, multi-evidence and OOD/abstention evaluation.

split_strategy.note: Use dev for tuning chunking/top-k/embedding/retrieval/reranker. Keep test untouched for final reporting.

schema_fields.question: Vietnamese query presented to the pipeline.
schema_fields.source_doc_tag: Short canonical document tag; null for OOD.
schema_fields.source_file: Canonical clean Markdown filename; null for OOD.
schema_fields.answerable: Whether the 7-document corpus contains sufficient evidence.
schema_fields.base_question_type: Underlying category when question_style is patient-oriented.
schema_fields.requires_table: Whether gold evidence is a Markdown table.
schema_fields.requires_multiple_evidence: Whether answering requires multiple evidence units.
schema_fields.gold_evidence: Chunker-independent gold evidence with exact source text, section path and line range.
schema_fields.reference_answer: Source-faithful extractive/composite reference answer or abstention target.
schema_fields.key_facts: Atomic facts expected in a correct answer.
schema_fields.evaluation_targets: Pipeline stages/metrics this record can support.

compatibility_note: The legacy run_embedding_eval.py that expects document-level ground_truth_sources should be updated to match retrieved chunks against gold_evidence/ground_truth_sections. Do not use document-only matching for final metrics.
